diff:
--- R2-golden
+++ R2-desired
@@ -2,6 +2,25 @@
 !
 management api http-commands
    no shutdown
+!
+dhcp server
+   subnet 192.168.10.0/24
+      range 192.168.10.101 192.168.10.254
+      default-gateway 192.168.10.1
+   !
+   subnet 192.168.20.0/24
+      range 192.168.20.101 192.168.20.254
+      default-gateway 192.168.20.1
+   !
+   subnet 2001:db8:5840:10::/64
+      range 2001:db8:5840:10::101 2001:db8:5840:10::ffff
+   !
+   subnet 2001:db8:5840:20::/64
+      range 2001:db8:5840:20::101 2001:db8:5840:20::ffff
+   !
+   subnet 2001:db8:5840:30::/64
+      range 2001:db8:5840:30::101 2001:db8:5840:30::ffff
+   !
 !
 no service interface inactive port-id allocation disabled
 !
@@ -15,6 +34,8 @@
 !
 snmp-server contact NMAS
 snmp-server location 5840-Lab
+snmp-server community 5840RO ro
+snmp-server host 172.20.20.1 version 2c 5840RO
 snmp-server enable traps snmp link-down
 snmp-server enable traps snmp link-up
 !
@@ -34,6 +55,8 @@
    description L3_TO_S2
    no switchport
    ip address 10.0.102.2/30
+   dhcp server ipv4
+   dhcp server ipv6
    ipv6 address 2001:db8:5840:102::2/64
    isis enable ACCESS
    isis network point-to-point
@@ -50,6 +73,8 @@
    description ROUTER_ID
    ip address 172.31.255.2/32
    ipv6 address 2001:db8:5840:ffff::2/128
+   isis enable ACCESS
+   isis passive
    ip ospf area 0.0.0.0
    ipv6 ospf 1 area 0.0.0.0
 !
@@ -58,6 +83,13 @@
    ipv6 address 3fff:172:20:20::4/64
 !
 ip routing
+!
+ip prefix-list OSPF-TO-RIP
+   seq 10 permit 192.168.100.0/24
+!
+ip prefix-list RIP-TO-OSPF
+   seq 10 permit 192.168.10.0/24
+   seq 20 permit 192.168.20.0/24
 !
 ip prefix-list WEB-IPV4
    seq 10 permit 192.168.100.0/24
@@ -80,8 +112,14 @@
 route-map ISIS-TO-OSPFV3 permit 10
    match ipv6 address prefix-list ISIS-V6-HOSTS
 !
+route-map OSPF-TO-RIP permit 10
+   match ip address prefix-list OSPF-TO-RIP
+!
 route-map OSPFV3-TO-ISIS permit 10
    match ipv6 address prefix-list OSPFV3-TO-ISIS
+!
+route-map RIP-TO-OSPF permit 10
+   match ip address prefix-list RIP-TO-OSPF
 !
 router isis ACCESS
    net 49.0001.0000.0000.0012.00
@@ -92,7 +130,7 @@
 !
 router ospf 1
    router-id 172.31.255.2
-   redistribute rip
+   redistribute rip route-map RIP-TO-OSPF
    max-lsa 12000
 !
 ipv6 router ospf 1
@@ -101,7 +139,7 @@
 !
 router rip
    network 10.0.102.0/30
-   redistribute ospf match external
+   redistribute ospf match external route-map OSPF-TO-RIP
    no shutdown
 !
 end
